dct_title_s: Papua New Guinea - Earthquake on Jan 21 2025
dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000plel](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000plel) Magnitude 5.5 earthquake at 10.0 depth occurred on Jan 21 2025 65km SW of Konos. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -3.7368 longitude 151.5823. It impacted 139 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
